description: Timed kit channels placed by the user (protocol-kit prep 3.5): a forwarding uart_tx_chan from a device's configured port to a VIP's export, timed by the device's configuration and passing it on; a sinking uart_txrx_chan between two devices' sockets, timed by each sender's configuration, setting frame_err once the configurations differ. The trace holds each receiver's last character and its delivery time.
